title: THE ONE authoritative readiness decision (box-status.operational_readiness)
description: SECTION 7. Source: src/box/operationalReadiness.ts buildOperationalReadiness(), driven by src/box/engine.ts operationalReadiness(). The SINGLE verdict a client must render instead of recombining raw facts. Readiness was previously answered in three disagreeing places: box-status (raw transports), GET /api/runtime/status (live_entry.blocked, computed from env/DB/token facts that included NEITHER transport lifecycle), and the frontend (its own matrix from market-data readiness plus one reconcile flag). Both HTTP surfaces are now projections of THIS decision. Entry and exposure permissions come from the SAME streamHealthPolicy combinedPermissions table the live-entry checkpoint enforces. NO SECRETS: states, counts, ages, booleans, bounded sentences and a MASKED account reference only — never a token, a passcode or a full account id. It promises nothing about fills, four-leg atomicity or maximum loss; entry.permitted means only that every observable precondition is currently satisfied.

decision_generation.description: Monotonic per-decision counter. A response carrying a LOWER value than one already rendered is STALE and must be IGNORED, never allowed to overwrite newer state.

decision_version.description: The version of this decision shape. A client that does not recognise it must degrade to 'unknown', never to a green light.

decided_at.description: Wall-clock ms at which the decision was evaluated. With decision_generation this is how a client tells current from stale.

account_masked.description: MASKED account reference, e.g. "AB••34". Never the raw id. Null when no account is bound.

account_present.description: Whether an account is bound at all — deliberately distinct from 'the id is hidden'.

state.description: The ACTUAL market-data lifecycle from the driven MarketDataStateMachine — not a feed_healthy boolean.

generation.description: Feed/session generation. Advances on every (re)authentication; a book observed under a superseded socket is not evidence for the new one.

usable_for_entry.description: True ONLY in READY: fresh usable depth per traded instrument in the current generation.

lifecycle.description: The AUTHORITATIVE order-stream lifecycle the entry gate scored. Defect (a) was that this could be DEGRADED while the published health said LIVE.

published_state.description: The same fact as published in order_stream.brokers[].health.state, DERIVED from the lifecycle above so the two cannot disagree.

fill_observation.description: The mechanism ACTUALLY responsible for observing a fill right now.

evidence.description: How old the evidence behind this decision is. NULL means NEVER OBSERVED — it must never render as a fresh 0. The four time facts are kept distinct: a heartbeat is not a depth update.

pending.description: True while a REST gap repair is owed. A gap is NEVER assumed empty; missing events are not zero fills.

entry.description: NEW ENTRY: the single verdict, plus every reason it was refused. A client MUST NOT show a permitted state when this is false.

exposure_management.description: REDUCING exposure, computed from reduction-scoped facts ONLY. THE INVARIANT: an entry-scoped restriction (stopped scanner, entry disabled, spent session budget, entry capital cap, one-active-underlying, unavailable reservations, entry-only market-data requirements, an unrelated symbol's stale book) can NEVER appear here and can never independently block a reduction. Reduction keeps its own genuine requirements — an expired session or an unpriceable book still refuses it, and says so.

limitations.description: What reduction cannot promise even when permitted. Always non-empty: permission is not a fill, four-leg atomicity is unavailable, and an unpriceable leg cannot be reduced on a limit price.
